summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi Digital Banking & Fintech Infrastructure ETF (KYC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund actively selects companies across the global digital banking and fintech infrastructure sector. It seeks capital appreciation and combines fundamental analysis, thematic screening, and quantitative methods in selecting securities. KYC was launched on May 6, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.

holdings.infoBox: KYC is an equity ETF with a total of 58 individual holdings. The top holdings are Visa Inc. stock at 9.65%, Mastercard at 8.35%, Robinhood Markets at 4.81%, MercadoLibre at 4.24%, and Sea Limited at 3.81%.
